enemy.name: Hymnoi Warrior
enemy.flavour_text: An elite warrior employed at the Hymnoi Training Base. Almost certainly holed up at the theater if it's a day off.

abilities.text: More likely to be targeted by attacks.
Receives a shield that lasts a short period of time (grants the unit 100% resistance to Physical, Arts, and True damage as well as Stun, Sleep, Bind, Slow, and Shift statuses)
When on the field, slightly reduces DEF of all allied units
When attacked, unleashes a rain of arrows on all deployed Operators, continuously dealing True damage over a short period of time. Duration is refreshed whenever attacked again
